title: LAG-MMLU: Benchmarking Frontier LLM Understanding in Latvian and Giriama
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. The performance analysis is aggregated across all 55 subjects, and there is no breakdown of model performance for the 'world_religions' category.
